beats.beat: In the Earlmere drying sheds, Garret teaches Elin the rule of the harvest: a glass leaf may only be cut once its central vein has turned fully silver, never before, or it will fall silent when it's needed.
Elin reaches for a borderline leaf and Garret stops her hand sharply, telling her the rule has never once failed him in all his years cutting.

Dessa Fenwick arrives at the mill shaken, carrying a dead detector bundle, and explains she nearly rode her mule straight into a hollow of bad air in the Ashfall Marches because the leaves never chimed.
Garret checks the bundle's tag against the batch number and realizes these leaves, though sold under Mabel Odell's mark, were never cut by any harvester he knows.

turn.note: Garret's line 'Nobody I know cut these' reframes the dead bundle from an accident into a mystery of forged harvest, setting up chapter 2's investigation.

listenability: Dessa's line 'my mule stopped at the lip of a hollow and would not go down, and I kicked her on, because these were on my saddle and these were quiet' shifts subject from mule to I to these across four clauses; split into two sentences.
'Odell's mark. Batch eleven, this autumn's cut.' uses 'eleven' as a batch number, which is fine, but confirm no larger digit strings appear elsewhere in the series for this batch.

generic_prose.quote: which she thought was a considerable act of discipline
generic_prose.replace_with: name the specific thing she does instead — bites the inside of her cheek, counts the leaves on the tray — rather than naming the restraint as a feeling

trope_note: Delivers the rule-that-must-not-be-broken straight (the silver-vein rule stated and enforced on page) and opens the apprentice thread through Elin's eagerness; the thing-nobody-has-studied trope is only hinted via the silent detector, appropriately held back for a later chapter.
fixes: Split Dessa's run-on sentence ('my mule stopped... because these were on my saddle and these were quiet') at 'and I kicked her on' so the subject doesn't drift from mule to narrator to leaves within one sentence.
Replace 'which she thought was a considerable act of discipline' with a concrete physical action that shows the restraint rather than naming it.
